svg.text: Rules that hold in every stage

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: - Each model call goes through the spend gate. ARC models are free;

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: a paid call that would take a run past $1 waits for the person.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: - Credits: Claude $20, OpenAI $15, with $10 held back for the demo.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: - Paid models see only public blackboard entries; arc_only text stays on ARC.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: - A model never reviews its own work: the reviewer is another family.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: - Every step is a blackboard entry: provenance, replay, audit trail.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Consolas, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: - Code decides coverage, approval and routing; a model's "approve" is not enough.
